summary:
Messages queue cleared under RBC-RX-05: 7 messages from 3 patients, all closed.

Samuel Price (pt-0030):
- Metformin 1000 mg twice daily renewed for 90 days with 1 refill (mr-t0002). His latest valid eGFR is 58 (corrected), and an outside HbA1c from 2026-08-19 is within the last 6 months. This one order covers his portal message and both pharmacy requests.
- Lisinopril 20 mg: I renewed it this morning, then a corrected creatinine came in. The 10/06 BMP now reads 1.49, up from 1.36. That BMP was drawn 18 days after the dose went up, and 1.49 is 35% above the 1.10 before the change, so the protocol treats it like a potassium of 5.5 or higher. I cancelled the renewal (mr-t0001), left the old order mr-00295 stopped, and created task-t0020 for your review. He says the 20 mg supply is finished, so he has no lisinopril until you decide.

Frank Odum (pt-0027):
- Lisinopril 10 mg: I first renewed it and ordered a repeat BMP (sr-t0006), because the August outside potassium of 5.9 was from a hemolyzed sample and doesn't count. Then a new St. Brigid BMP arrived, collected 10/20 from a good sample, with potassium 5.8. I cancelled the renewal (mr-t0003), left mr-00283 stopped, and created task-t0021 for your review. sr-t0006 is still open and may not be needed now; I had no tool to cancel it. His hernia repair is now 11/12.

Marcus Webb (pt-0031):
- Metformin 500 mg twice daily renewed for 90 days with 1 refill (mr-t0005). His eGFR of 39 on 10/14 was entered in error. His valid eGFR is 92 and his HbA1c is from 9/28.
- Lisinopril 10 mg: he hasn't had a BMP in the last 12 months, so I gave a 30-day supply and ordered a BMP (sr-t0007). Then a potassium of 5.8 from 10/22 arrived. I cancelled the 30-day supply (mr-t0004), left mr-00297 stopped, and created task-t0022 for your review. The BMP order stays open.

All three tasks are marked urgent and due 10/26. I didn't place any new or changed lisinopril orders.

Each patient got a reply this morning, then a corrected message after the new results came in. I wrote a protocol note for each one (doc-t0027, doc-t0028, doc-t0029).

Your results queue still has open items. Three are the new results above (inbox-a0001, a0003, a0004); I left them open, and the three tasks cover them. Seven others are for other patients and outside this request, including critical potassiums for pt-0016 (6.3) and pt-0008 (6.4).
